newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin will met U.S. Secretary of State Madeline Albright in Washington during an official visit there next month, spokeswoman Gilda Lazar said in the weekly news briefing.
* Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea arrived in Budapest in a first official visit since his appointment last year. Hungary and Romania are expected to sign accords to boost economic cooperation.
* The Defence Ministry is likely to get in 1997 a budget representing 3.0 percent of the GDP, Defence Minister Victor Babiuc told a news conference. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
